description: We are passionate about interplanetary exploration and mapping unkown territories and we want to know hoe objects near us change their apparent positions.
summary:
Our project is an interactive web tool designed to help people explore and understand how stars move across the sky over time. We focused on five high-proper-motion stars and developed a way to visualize their positions and movement.

Inspired by NASA's SPHEREx mission, our goal is to make space science easier to understand and more accessible to everyone. By presenting astronomical information visually, our project helps students, researchers, and space enthusiasts explore changes in the night sky and encourages curiosity about our universe.
details:
Our team developed a web-based visualization focused on five stars: Barnard's Star, Epsilon Indi B, Wise 0855, RW Aurigae and R Draconis our fifth selected star.

The purpose of our project is to help users understand stellar movement by displaying star positions and illustrating how they change over time.

We chose this topic because space data can be difficult for beginners to understand. We wanted to create something educational, interactive, and accessible to people who are curious about astronomy.

Our project was inspired by NASA's SPHEREx mission and its goal of studying the sky. We hope our visualization encourages students and the public to explore astronomy and understand how observations can reveal changes in the universe.
